title: A count or list question the query log captures is not written into _gaps.md as a kb gap
goal: ql_apply.gap_decision gives a question a tool answers (how many articles or sources a domain holds) a decision other than keep; a question the kb lacks a fact for still gets keep

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import ql_apply
g = ql_apply.Gate()
qs = ['How many articles does the kb hold in the intune domain?', 'How many sources does the kb cite in the mecm domain?']
d = {q: ql_apply.gap_decision(q, g)[2] for q in qs}
print(d); sys.exit(1 if any(v == 'keep' for v in d.values()) else 0)
